name: Iron Sentry
look: a wide white armoured sphere with a black face band of glowing red dots, red-banded shoulder spheres, thin black arms with long glowing red fingers, on a round platform and two short legs
entry: A Pokémon resembling Registeel, said to be the guardian described in a report on a sealed vault. Its long red fingers can reach through steel walls, and it patrols the same corridors without rest, as if still following orders given by someone long gone.
how: Wild: very rare inside trial chambers.
